name: Lovas (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, light grey and green in the ratio 2:1:2, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lovas: a blue and green shield with ears of grain, a bunch of grapes and a white ploughshare, bordered in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
